tex_content.html:
\begin{claim} \end{claim}[Lower bound on the velocity integral before exiting a fixed ball] If $\gamma $ first leaves $P(x,T,r/2,-r^2)$ at time $\tau ''$ in the preceding lemma, then $\int _0^{\tau ''}|X_\gamma |\, d\tau >r/(2\sqrt2)$. \end{claim}
Proof

\sketch Curvature control gives $e^{-2r^{-2}\tau ''}G(T)\leq G(T-\tau '')\leq e^{2r^{-2}\tau ''}G(T)$, and the choice of $\tau ''$ makes the distortion less than $2$. The final point has $G(T)$-distance $r/2$ from $x$.

□
